title: Code and frozen results for: Reliable Evaluation of Transductive Population Graph Neural Networks for Multisite Autism fMRI
description: Reproducibility software for multisite population-graph evaluation. Version 1.2.0 adds manifest-validated R3 statistics and compact test-prediction inputs for 528 directed, 528 bidirectional and 270 support-sampling fits. The positive paired effect is implementation-conditional and does not survive bidirectional edges. Withdrawn per-site significance tests are not recomputed. Original cohort release data remain available. No primary imaging data or end-to-end R3 training-input rebuild is supplied.
